# Overview

## Row {height="30%"}

### Project Introduction

**Dataset:** All Candidate Neighborhoods for Connection-Based Revitalization

**Link:** https://opportunityinsights.org/data/

**High-Level Questions:** 

1. Where are the largest opportunity gaps, and how are they distributed geographically?

2. How do opportunity outcomes relate to neighborhood demographics and conditions?

3. How have population percentages and monetary statistics changed from 2010 to 2020 and where are those changes most significant? 

4. What are the common metrics between neighborhoods that were selected for project funding and obtained a positive upward mobility score? 


## Row {height="70%"}

### Geographic Distribution of Opportunity Gaps
```{python}

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio
pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"
# Load Dataset(For this demo only)
df = pd.read_csv("HOPEVI_All_Candidate_Neighborhoods.csv", thousands=",")
map_df = df.dropna(subset=["lat", "lon", "opportunity_gap","total_pop_2020", "neighborhood"]).sample(n=2000, random_state=114514)  # Sample for demo purposes
# This is not the actual data cleaning. DO NOT USE THIS FOR THE ACTUAL PROJECT!!!

fig = px.scatter_geo(
    map_df,
    lat=map_df["lat"],
    lon=map_df["lon"],
    color=map_df["opportunity_gap"],
    size=map_df["total_pop_2020"],
    scope="usa",
    hover_name=map_df["neighborhood"],
    color_continuous_scale="RdBu",
    title="Geographic Distribution of Neighborhood Opportunity Gaps (Demo)"
)

fig.update_traces(
    marker=dict(
        line=dict(width=0),
        opacity=0.7
    )
)
fig.show()
```

# Population Percentage Change

## Row

### Plot

```{python}
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio
pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"
df[income_change_2010_2020] = df[median_household_income_2020] - df[median_household_income_2010]
fig1 = px.histogram(
    df,
    x="income_change_2010_2020",
    nbins="10",
    title="Distribution of Income Changes"
)

fig1.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Change in Median Household Income from 2010 to 2020",
    yaxis_title="Number of Census Tracts",
)

fig1.add_annotation(
    text=":) Placeholder",
    x=0.5,
    y=0.5,
    xref="paper",
    yref="paper",
    showarrow=False
)

fig1.show()
```
### Plot

```{python}
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio
pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"
df_sorted = df.sort_values(by="income_change_2010_2020", ascending=True)
fig1 = px.bar(
    df_sorted,
    x="income_change_2010_2020",
    y="city",
    orientation="h"
    title="Ranked Bar Chart of Change in Median Household Income from 2010 to 2020"
)
    
fig1.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Change in Median Household Income from 2010 to 2020",
    yaxis_title="City"
)   
    
fig1.add_annotation(
    text=":) Placeholder",
    x=0.5,
    y=0.5,
    xref="paper",
    yref="paper",
    showarrow=False
)

## Metrics for High and Low Upward Mobility Scores

### Plot

```{python}
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio
pio.templates.default = "plotly_white"
df_selected = df[df['flag_selected'] == 1]
fig1 = px.box(
    df_selected,
    y = "poverty_rate_2020",
    title="Distribution of Poverty Rate for Selected Tracts in 2020"
)

fig1.update_layout(
    xaxis_title="Tract",
    yaxis_title="Poverty Rate (2020)",
)

fig1.add_annotation(
    text=":) Placeholder",
    x=0.5,
    y=0.5,
    xref="paper",
    yref="paper",
    showarrow=False
)

fig1.show()
```
### Plot

```{python}
import plotly.express as px
